start.card:
You're riding a Ferris wheel at the fair. Its spokes (the bars from the hub, the wheel's centre, out to the rim) are 20 m long.
You get on level with the hub. A quarter turn, 90°, takes you to the very top.
Guess first: compare a 30° turn with a 60° turn (twice as far). How high does 60° lift you, compared with 30°?
start.title: Sunset Ferris Wheel
visibleButtons: Higher, but less than twice as high

afterGuess.card:
You picked "Twice as high". Let's find out.
Drag your orange car up the wheel, or use the Turn slider. Stop at 30° first and read your height.
afterGuess.title: Sunset Ferris Wheel

after.card:
At 30° you are 10.0 m up: half of the 20 m spoke.
Now keep turning to 60°. Will you be twice as high?
after.title: Sunset Ferris Wheel
